explanation: Refused because eta electroproduction ep -> e'p eta is kinematically forbidden at W = 1.2 GeV. Using the masses in the eta EXCLURAD configuration (m_p = 0.938272 GeV and m_eta = 0.54786 GeV), the production threshold is W_thr = m_p + m_eta = 1.486132 GeV. Since 1.2 GeV < 1.486132 GeV, no physical eta final state exists at the requested point, so no valid EXCLURAD input was generated.
